sections.title: Right now
lines: Pregame build, kickoff Sun 8:30am CT. Sold 70, 2,626 resting. Worst line -$58 (goal -$75).

sections.title: Lagging sides
lines: Lagging (75+ behind the leader): HOU by 1-6, HOU by 7-14, HOU by 15+, JAC by 1-6, JAC by 7-14.
HOU by 1-6: 70 behind. No crowd trade data yet.
HOU by 7-14: 70 behind. No crowd trade data yet.
A price step needs 10 min with no fill and the crowd paying less.

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: A side gets a new batch when its resting drops under 25% of launch.
Gate open: worst line -$58 is better than -$100.
Closest: JAC by 15+, 381 resting vs trigger 94.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It trips if the worst line falls under -$150.
Paid balancing starts Sun 7:45am CT: worst line to -$75 by Sun 8:20am CT, up to $50.
At Sun 8:00am CT, if worst line is -$75 or better, paid balancing stops.
Kickoff Sun 8:30am CT: the in-game engine takes over.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: price steps, new batches and paid balancing run by rule. It will not reprice for line moves or news.
